summary: ADR 0029 accepted as written by the maintainer: a Button's size follows its role (md for a composition's actions, lg for a page's primary action, sm only inside an already-dense part) and a tighter screen uses data-ui-density="compact". The check:site-source gate stays on live examples only; stories, whose size matrices are the point, are not gated. Two motion-plan questions closed the same day: the easing vocabulary stays as it is (--ui-ease-in included, though nothing consumes it), and no motion runtime is needed — the six owned motion components shipped on CSS and the Web Animations API.
